name: lingyu-naming
description: Chinese personal-name consultant generating and vetting names by meaning, phonology, character form, homophones and duplication risk

displayDescription.en: Generates Chinese given names from your surname, style and taboo characters, checking meaning, tone, character form, homophones and duplication risk. Sources cited only when verifiable; no fortune-telling.
displayDescription.zh: 按姓氏、风格与避讳生成中文姓名，逐字核查音形义、谐音与重名热度，出处可核验才标注，不批命不断吉凶。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to name my child

quickPrompts.en: I want to name my child
Give 8 elegant three-character names for the surname Li, avoiding trendy characters
quickPrompts.zh: 姓李，起 8 个三字名，风格典雅，避开爆款字

quickPrompts.en: Compare these candidate names and tell me the risks
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我比较这几个候选名，看看各自有什么风险
